import ctypes
import os

def permute_vector(input_vector, permutation):
    # Load libraries in correct order
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    n = len(input_vector)
    
    # Create GSL vector
    gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    gsl.gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    vec_ptr = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(n)
    
    # Copy input data to GSL vector
    for i in range(n):
        gsl.gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
        gsl.gsl_vector_set(vec_ptr, i, ctypes.c_double(input_vector[i]))
    
    # Create GSL permutation
    gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    perm_ptr = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    
    # Set up permutation structure
    gsl.gsl_permutation_init.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_init(perm_ptr)
    
    # Get pointer to permutation data
    gsl.gsl_permutation_data.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_data.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    perm_data = gsl.gsl_permutation_data(perm_ptr)
    
    # Copy permutation values
    for i in range(n):
        perm_data[i] = permutation[i]
    
    # Apply permutation
    gsl.gsl_permute_vector.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
    gsl.gsl_permute_vector.restype = ctypes.c_int
    result = gsl.gsl_permute_vector(perm_ptr, vec_ptr)
    
    if result != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL permutation failed with error code: {result}")
    
    # Extract result
    output = []
    gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
    for i in range(n):
        output.append(int(gsl.gsl_vector_get(vec_ptr, i)))
    
    # Clean up
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(vec_ptr)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(perm_ptr)
    
    return output

def assert_test():
    # Test 1: Basic permutation
    vec = [10, 20, 30, 40]
    perm = [2, 0, 3, 1]
    result = permute_vector(vec, perm)
    assert result == [30, 10, 40, 20], f"Expected [30, 10, 40, 20], got {result}"
    
    # Test 2: Identity permutation
    vec = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    perm = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    result = permute_vector(vec, perm)
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], f"Expected [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], got {result}"
    
    # Test 3: Reverse permutation
    vec = [100, 200, 300]
    perm = [2, 1, 0]
    result = permute_vector(vec, perm)
    assert result == [300, 200, 100], f"Expected [300, 200, 100], got {result}"
    
    # Test 4: Single element
    vec = [42]
    perm = [0]
    result = permute_vector(vec, perm)
    assert result == [42], f"Expected [42], got {result}"
    
    # Test 5: Large values
    vec = [1000, 2000, 3000]
    perm = [1, 2, 0]
    result = permute_vector(vec, perm)
    assert result == [2000, 3000, 1000], f"Expected [2000, 3000, 1000], got {result}"
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
